name: Jahsera
title: Descendant of Asher
summary: Jahsera (also spelled Jisra or Jisva) is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Asher through his son Beriah. He appears in the genealogies of the tribe of Asher and is otherwise little mentioned in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Asher
keyEvents.description: Jahsera is listed as one of the sons of Beriah, son of Asher, in the detailed genealogy in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Sons of Asher Listed in Genesis
keyEvents.description: In the family tree of Jacob's sons in Genesis, the descendants of Asher are mentioned, including the sons of Beriah, among whom Jahsera (Jisva) is included.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Asher in Numbers
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Asher was mustered during the wilderness journey, and the descendants of Jahsera were part of this tribe counted in the census.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's Blessing over Asher
keyEvents.description: The patriarch Jacob blessed his son Asher with the promise of rich food and royal delicacies, a blessing that applied to the entire lineage of Asher, including Jahsera.
